name: rate_limit_fallback
description: Runbook row: Redis pressure and fallback (MONITORING-RUNBOOK.md, Runtime observations). Counts rate_limit_fallback warnings emitted by app.operational (backend/app/services/rate_limit.py, a limiter operation failing to use Redis and taking its local fallback), already throttled to at most one record per 600 seconds per process. rate_limit_redis_success_after_fallback intentionally has no metric: it must not automatically resolve a fleet incident, per the runbook's own signal-plan table. Validate this time series exists before activating the referencing alert policy.
